arguments.name: raceCode
arguments.description:
Race code to search (exact match).
Uses search criteria RAC_CODE and returns the record whose Code matches exactly.

raw.name: raceCode
raw.description:
Race code to search (exact match).
Uses search criteria RAC_CODE and returns the record whose Code matches exactly.

arguments.name: searchRaceName
arguments.description:
Race name (or partial text) to search.
Uses search criteria RAC_NAME and returns all rows whose Race Name contains the given text (case-insensitive).

raw.name: searchRaceName
raw.description:
Race name (or partial text) to search.
Uses search criteria RAC_NAME and returns all rows whose Race Name contains the given text (case-insensitive).

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing races, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list".
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Page size value sent to the grid pager (server may cap). Default is "100".

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Page size value sent to the grid pager (server may cap). Default is "100".

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety cap for the maximum number of pages to iterate (prevents infinite loops). Default is "50".

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description: Safety cap for the maximum number of pages to iterate (prevents infinite loops). Default is "50".
